dishes.name: Polenta ticinese
dishes.desc: Slow-cooked cornmeal, served with braised meat, cheese or mushrooms. The old staple of Ticino, found in the grottos around Lugano.

dishes.name: Luganighe
dishes.desc: Fresh pork sausage of Lugano and Ticino, grilled or cooked in risotto. It is traditionally served with polenta and opens Lugano's carnival.

dishes.name: Risotto ticinese
dishes.desc: Creamy risotto with local rice and Merlot or sausage, a Ticino staple. Almost every grotto and restaurant in the Lugano area has one.

dishes.name: Brasato al Merlot
dishes.desc: Beef slowly braised in Merlot, served with polenta. A hearty Ticino main course found in grottos and trattorias.

dishes.name: Torta di pane
dishes.desc: Dense bread pudding with raisins, pine nuts and sometimes cocoa. A traditional Ticino cake found in bakeries and pasticcerie of the Lugano region.
